title: (ARCHIVED) Christy's Resources
description: A personal resource pack to make changes and tweaks to many things.
body:
# This resource pack is archived because I want to split things into several resource packs, such as the glowing mature crops and the special font. Be sure to check those out if you likey!

This is a mostly-personalized resource pack I made for fun, but with the idea of publishing this as a work of mine, I've put more effort into the whole thing and am making this as organized and clean as possible!

## GUI and HUD
* Changes the panorama to the panorama from Legacy Console edition title update 5
  * [Thanks to jesus7842 on mcpedl.com for these!](https://mcpedl.com/legacy-console-panoramas/)
* Replaces the default splash texts with mostly personal jokes
* Colors the UI blue and reshapes round GUI to be more square
> ![Example of Title Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c7241615e6c7d936513eda278eebc2fb2fa8374.png)
* Differentiates whether you can't connect to a server because it's either unreachable or incompatible using the ping icon
* Changes all the hotbar icons to be square
* Colors the hotbar a saturated brown to look more wooden
> ![Example of Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb5f743841d0aedf68f481cafc1e9325ccff314a.png)
* Shows what block you're interacting with in the top left of most container GUI
> ![Example of Crafting Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d14af04651a688a215fc17e72040fa2704ebdeb.png)
* Replaces the carved pumpkin aperture with an orange outline around your screen
> ![Example of Pumpkin Outline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e15a4289bc2ce92fbba4e007c239e64d64f8cd70.png)
* Replaces the frost effect with a blue outline around your screen
* Redesignes ASCII characters to be slightly thinner and serifed
* Shades ASCII characters
## Blocks, items, and environment
* Changes the destroying textures to an open X that shrinks inwards, followed by a full square that expands outwards until it reaches the ends of the block
* Grants a colored, white-pulsing outline around ores
* Gives torches a flame animation
* Redesigns glow lichen to look more like a lantern while retaining its pallete
* Makes ripe crops pulse white
* Pixelatedly rounds the sun and moon
* Retextures the entity shadow to be a pixelatedly rounded square
* Retextures the map background to be a black-and-white border with full transparency where the contents of the map show up

### Christy's Resources affects:
* Appleskin
* Simple Voice Chat
* Dynamic Crosshair
